source_evidence: Exact player 'The free market. Offer them something they can’t walk away from.' proposes competing for voluntary loyalty by providing compelling benefits, not physically preventing departure, accepting existing coercion, signing a settlement or committing House funds. Caul initially amused, then seriously considers favorable rents, reliable protection, guaranteed produce buyers, paid work and compensated genuinely willing blood contributors, and attraction of subjects by reputation instead of conquest. These are prospective examples, not agreed prices, established financial viability, actual purchases, magical effects or delivered services. Mara supports the incentive argument. Caul's self-interest in durable rule and recognition by the claimant makes her willing to test this approach in one of her existing dependent communities, with freedom to depart, no forced labor/blood tribute, voluntary paid services and meaningful economic terms; proposes that if the experiment succeeds V recognize her continued stewardship under such terms. This is an offer, no V assent, pilot started, community selected, funded budget, guaranteed success, full regime reform or waiver of accountability. Independently, as a calculated good-faith concession to the recognized heir, she writes and seals an unconditional order to Voss to release the two adults currently confined at the western customs tower for refused hereditary levy, without payment or renewed oath as a release condition. She instructs castellan to dispatch existing manor yard Guard with the order; Guard departs at approximately20:07 Day334 along existing12 rough miles to tower, ordinary foot travel about8h, earliest uninterrupted arrival04:07 Day335; no extra courier, delivery/compliance, actual release, title transfer, bounty or wider suspension established. Manor now gate/receiving Veterans, stair Guard, counting Spy, castellan, two spawn cellar, Ysendre archive; original yard Guard traveling, other tower personnel unchanged. The two prisoners remain last established alive at tower pending actual delivery/compliance. No new random roll for ordinary NPC voluntary decisions and dispatched order; no combat, Charm, costs charged to V, game rest or resource changes. D334~20:07, Caul asks if V would recognize stewardship proven by genuinely voluntary allegiance. V next choice.
